sections.changelog:
Added

  • `[mvweb-cp]` with no attributes now lists the children of the page it sits on, so the most common case no longer requires looking up a page ID. On a singular view the parent is resolved through `get_queried_object_id()`, which survives another shortcode or a nested query overwriting the global `$post`
  • Column count is now a setting: General tab → «Columns» (Auto, 2, 3, 4) and a matching `columns` shortcode attribute. Auto keeps the current behaviour; a fixed count still collapses to two columns on tablets and one on phones
  • General tab: «Text when the list is empty» — shown to everyone in place of the list when the parent page has no published children. Empty field keeps the current behaviour of rendering nothing
  • Users who can edit content now see why a list is missing (wrong ID, parent unpublished, password-protected, no children) instead of an empty spot. Visitors still get the silent HTML comment
  • Help tab: quick start rewritten around the attribute-less shortcode, `columns` added to the attributes table, FAQ entries on the empty-list message, on column count and on reading the on-page diagnostics

Changed

  • «Image size» now sets the pixel box the image is drawn in — full card width (the previous look), a 100/200/300 square, or a custom width × height — instead of picking a registered WordPress size. The box is applied with CSS and the image is cropped with `object-fit`, so nothing new is generated on the server and the setting works on sites where WordPress never created the intermediate sizes (a 300px upload has no «large» file, which is why every option used to produce exactly the same picture). The shortcode takes the same values, including pairs like `image_size="240x160"`; the old `thumbnail`/`medium`/`large` values keep rendering what they render today
  • «Default limit» no longer asks for `-1`: the field is left empty to show every child page, and the placeholder says «All». Existing values keep working, `-1` is simply never shown to the user again

Fixed

  • MVweb Hub: the hub page now carries `.mvweb-settings`, the UI Kit's documented activator. Recent Kit versions scope their element resets to it, so on sites without an older plugin the hub was rendering without `box-sizing` and heading styles. The Kit now also accepts `.mvweb-hub` as a scope root, which fixes the page regardless of which plugin's copy of the hub class happens to run (shared class bumped to 2.6.1)
  • MVweb Hub: the newest-wins loader for the bundled hub class had no effect — PHP binds a top-level class at compile time, so the first copy required won before Phase 1 could bail out. The class declaration is now guarded by `class_exists()`, so the highest-versioned copy is the one that runs
  • Frontend styles are enqueued for the empty-list and diagnostics output as well — those return early, before the point where the stylesheet used to be registered
